## Intent
Hypothesis: compiler auto-vectorization of the integration loop combined with a register-resident fused decide/respawn/render pass can approach the streaming ceiling by eliminating intermediate storage.

## Layout & approach
The 68 B/p AoS layout offers loop 1 only 24 hot bytes (pos+vel, 35%) and the fused loop 2 only 36 (age+color+pos+seed, 52%) — the rest is dead weight per line. No intermediate storage keeps the death verdict in registers, but loop 2 is inherently scalar: per-particle death check, conditional `call spawn`, byte-granular framebuffer writes. All measured N exceed L1d spill (N≈481) and L2 spill (N≈7710), so 48–65% dead bytes stream through L3 or DRAM.

## Cache saturation
Cost is flat within each regime: ~24 ns/p at q=0.01 across L3-resident N (10K–100K), rising only ~3 ns/p at the L3→DRAM transition (N≈247K) to ~27 at N=1M, then flat through N=10M. No sharp knee — the algo never approaches bandwidth saturation. At q=0.5 the same shape holds, shifted up ~8 ns/p: added cost is respawn-path instruction count, not cache pressure. Eliminating intermediates does not help because dead bytes still stream through.

## Bandwidth
Achieved 2.82–2.87 GB/s at q=0.01 L3, 2.52–2.63 at DRAM — 20–23% of the 12.69 GB/s ceiling. Against the 5.359 ns/p floor, at 24–36 ns/p the algo spends at most ~22% on irreducible memory. Frontend_stall dominates at 63–70%; backend_stall rises to 12–14% only at DRAM. The algo is 0.92–1.04x baseline (parity with naive scalar) and 1.8–3.1x slower than the winner. The winner gap narrows with death rate (3.1x at q=0.01 vs 1.85x at q=0.5) — branchy respawn drags both down.

## Assembly
Loop 1 processes one particle per iteration (stride 0x44=68 B) with intra-particle packing: `vmovups` loads 16 B, `vshufps`/`vinsertps` rearrange pos+vel, `vmulps`/`vaddps` on 4 floats — within one particle, not across particles. The histogram records zero wide-vector instructions. Loop 2 is fully scalar: `vucomiss` (11×) for death checks, `jae`/`jne` branches, `call spawn`, byte-granular framebuffer stores via `movzx`+`add`+`cmp`+`cmovae`+`mov BYTE PTR`. The 357-instruction body's many branch paths drive 63–70% frontend_stall; scalar `vcvttss2si` and byte stores cap bandwidth far below ceiling.

## Verdict
Refuted — 0.92–1.04x of naive scalar (parity) and 1.8–3.1x slower than the winner at every N×q point. The "autovec" produced only intra-particle component packing (`vmulps` within one 68-B stride), not cross-particle vectorization, and the fused loop 2's scalar byte stores and branchy respawn drive 63–70% frontend stall. At q=0.01 the algo sustains just 2.87 GB/s (23% of ceiling); at q=0.5 the gap narrows to 1.85x only because respawn penalizes both. Register-resident verdict eliminates intermediates but cannot overcome AoS dead bytes and frontend pressure.
